display_long_description:
Mission Rift turns your real environment into a mission-driven battleground. Your space sits above a dangerous rift, and you play as a secret agent defending it from spiders, soldiers, robots, ghosts, turrets, and dark creatures breaching in from an alternate reality. Fight through story chapters where terrifying worlds line up with your real layout.

Map out multiple rooms and very large areas that shape into a massive battlefield, creating an experience that is both suspenseful and exhilarating. Enemies can flank, ambush, drop on you, and take cover using the environment around you.

Fight back with over 30 weapons, from pistols to rocket launchers, each with different damage, while experiencing environmental destruction effects throughout combat.

Featuring Story Mode, (Advanced Mesh Sandbox (Quest3/3s)), and Spider Kill, where you survive and eliminate as many spiders as possible under a time limit. More content to come.

*Important
- Quest 3 / Quest 3S and newer headsets support all game modes including Advanced Mapping Missions, allowing the game to scan and use more complex real-world environments.

- Quest 2 players can still play Story Mode and Spider Kill Mode using Meta’s manual room setup, where walls and doors are placed manually. Advanced Mapping-Sandbox modes are not available on older headsets because the headset does not support the same environment-mapping features.

If you enjoyed Mission Rift, please leave a review. Your support helps fund future updates!
